mapper.insert: INSERT INTO transactions ( transaction_id, account_id, order_id, instrument_id, transaction_type, quantity, price, amount, currency, balance_before, balance_after, idempotency_key, created_at ) VALUES ( #{transactionId}, #{accountId}, #{orderId}, #{instrumentId}, #{transactionType}, #{quantity}, #{price}, #{amount}, #{currency}, #{balanceBefore}, #{balanceAfter}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{createdAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT t.transaction_id AS transactionId, t.account_id AS accountId, t.transaction_type AS type, ROUND(t.amount, 2) AS amount, t.currency AS currency, ROUND(t.balance_before, 2) AS balanceBefore, ROUND(t.balance_after, 2) AS balanceAfter, t.created_at AS createdAt FROM transactions t WHERE t.account_id = #{accountId} AND t.transaction_type IN ('DEPOSIT', 'WITHDRAWAL') ORDER BY t.created_at DESC, t.transaction_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
